# `scripts/post-process/postprocess_old.py`

Source: [postprocess_old.py](../../../../scripts/post-process/postprocess_old.py)

Earlier version of `postprocess.py` (kept for reference).

## Contents

- [`out_file_root`](#out_file_root) - Output path prefix `<sim_path><stem>/stats/<quant>/<tag>_<snap>` (directory created).
- [`do_this_snap`](#do_this_snap) - All post-processing of one snapshot (see the module docstring); writes the outputs and logs the time.
- [`estimate_2pcf`](#estimate_2pcf) - Halo two-point correlation function of positions `hpos` in a box `Lbox` (real or redshift space along `los`) with `njn` jackknife regions, using the external `General_FITS_selection` and `ccorr_utility_nopc` codes; returns a dict of results.
- [`create_nested_directory`](#create_nested_directory) - Create `path` and its parents (at most `max_depth` levels); True on success.
- [`small_number_to_filename`](#small_number_to_filename) - A number as a file-name-safe string: 1.5e-4 -&gt; `1p50em4`.
- [`is_perfect_power`](#is_perfect_power) - Indicates (with True/False) if the provided number is a perfect power.
- [`add_pbc_jncol`](#add_pbc_jncol) - If the input is a periodic box and los is along z axis then jacknife region is simply equal area region in the x-y space which can be done in using this function and not needed to be supplied with data file. If njn is perfect cube then 3d jacknife is implemented If njn is perfect square then jn split is in x-y plane

## out_file_root

```python
out_file_root(sr, snap, quant='Pk', tag='')
```

Output path prefix `<sim_path><stem>/stats/<quant>/<tag>_<snap>` (directory created).

## do_this_snap

```python
do_this_snap(snap)
```

All post-processing of one snapshot (see the module docstring); writes the outputs and logs the time.

## estimate_2pcf

```python
estimate_2pcf(hpos, njn=0, Lbox=250, los=1, space='real', randfactor=2, interactive=1, xi2droot=None, xiprojroot=None)
```

Halo two-point correlation function of positions `hpos` in a box `Lbox` (real or redshift space
along `los`) with `njn` jackknife regions, using the external `General_FITS_selection` and
`ccorr_utility_nopc` codes; returns a dict of results.

## create_nested_directory

```python
create_nested_directory(path, max_depth=20)
```

Create `path` and its parents (at most `max_depth` levels); True on success.

## small_number_to_filename

```python
small_number_to_filename(number)
```

A number as a file-name-safe string: 1.5e-4 -&gt; `1p50em4`.

## is_perfect_power

```python
is_perfect_power(number, power)
```

Indicates (with True/False) if the provided number is a perfect power.

## add_pbc_jncol

```python
add_pbc_jncol(data, rand=None, Lbox=200, njn=0, los=1)
```

If the input is a periodic box and los is along z axis then jacknife region is simply equal area region in the x-y space which can be done in using this function and not needed to be supplied with data file.
If njn is perfect cube then 3d jacknife is implemented
If njn is perfect square then jn split is in x-y plane
